thread:
marco: quick flag observability migration doc has an anchor link that 404s (#cost-breakdown). can someone update to the console route?

anya: where is that anchor? i can search and open a small PR.

marco: it's in the 'Quick pointers' section, near the top. link currently points to /docs/obs#cost-breakdown which our site build rewrites badly. change to https://app.redwood.ai/console/observability/costs or the relative /console/observability/costs.

kevin: noted. while i'm there, the node snippet uses the old sdk signature `new Client({key})` which fails in our published pkg v2. i'll fix to `import {Redwood} from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })` and add a tiny migration note.

anya: nice. can you also add a one-line callout pointing to the per-request token cost breakdown in Console (Console > Observability > Token costs)? support sees this confusion a lot.

kevin: will do. i'll also replace a broken image link: `![costs](https://storage.redwood.ai/missing/cost-panel.png)` with the new export from design and add alt text.

marco: one more: add a small snippet showing how to toggle tracing hook attribute names for older telemetry: `if (span.attributes.serviceVersion) { span.setAttribute('deployment', span.attributes.serviceVersion) }`. saves triage.

kevin: added a short legacy shim and a one-line changelog bullet under 'What changed'. creating PR 2102 now.

docbot: automated check: PR 2102 by kevin includes anchor fix, node snippet update, shim, image replacement. staging preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/2102 no broken links found.

anya: quick review left, requesting one small wording tweak on the changelog line.

kevin: updated wording, pushed. merging after green CI.

docbot: PR 2102 merged to main by kevin at 1759991390. CI deploy: success.
